sentences.text: Marcos estaba muy nervioso porque era su primer día de trabajo.
sentences.translation: Marcos was very nervous because it was his first day at work.

sentences.text: Llegó temprano a la oficina para causar una buena impresión.
sentences.translation: He arrived early at the office to make a good impression.

sentences.text: Su jefa le explicó las tareas que tendría que hacer.
sentences.translation: His boss explained the tasks he would have to do.

sentences.text: Al principio no entendía bien el programa del ordenador.
sentences.translation: At first he did not understand the computer program well.

sentences.text: Una compañera amable le ayudó con paciencia.
sentences.translation: A kind colleague helped him patiently.

sentences.text: Durante la comida, conoció al resto del equipo.
sentences.translation: During lunch, he met the rest of the team.

sentences.text: Por la tarde ya se sentía más tranquilo y seguro.
sentences.translation: By the afternoon he already felt calmer and more confident.

sentences.text: Cuando volvió a casa, pensó que todo había salido bien.
sentences.translation: When he got home, he thought that everything had gone well.

sentences.text: Estaba contento y con ganas de volver al día siguiente.
sentences.translation: He was happy and eager to return the next day.

sentences.text: El verano pasado, Elena y sus amigos decidieron viajar a la montaña.
sentences.translation: Last summer, Elena and her friends decided to travel to the mountains.

sentences.text: Prepararon las mochilas con comida, agua y ropa de abrigo.
sentences.translation: They packed their backpacks with food, water and warm clothes.

sentences.text: El viaje en tren duró tres horas.
sentences.translation: The train journey lasted three hours.

sentences.text: Cuando llegaron, el paisaje era impresionante.
sentences.translation: When they arrived, the landscape was impressive.

sentences.text: Caminaron por un sendero hasta un lago azul.
sentences.translation: They walked along a path to a blue lake.

sentences.text: Aunque estaban cansados, se sentían felices.
sentences.translation: Although they were tired, they felt happy.

sentences.text: Por la noche, durmieron en una pequeña cabaña.
sentences.translation: At night, they slept in a small cabin.

sentences.text: Al día siguiente, prometieron que volverían pronto.
sentences.translation: The next day, they promised they would return soon.
